verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents webhook/IPN notifications, an MCP server that can configure and monitor webhooks, a CLI that operates payments and subscriptions with one token, and automatic retries for rejected subscription payments. Together these let an agent watch payment events and work within a platform-managed retry flow. missing for 10: agent-driven retry control (retries are automatic and subscription-only), any dunning or customer outreach capability, explicit failed-payment event documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: Automatic retries if a payment is rejected.
With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
